gap.prompt: The scheme was abandoned ___ widespread criticism.
gap.explain: In the face of means despite or when facing.

gap.prompt: Not until the audit was completed ___ the extent of the losses.
The contract is subject ___ approval by the board.

gap.explain: Be cleared of means be found not guilty.

gap.prompt: The evidence points ___ a systemic failure.
She was ___ to accept the terms under pressure.
gap.explain: Be compelled to means be forced to.
However can mean in whatever way here.

gap.prompt: The findings call ___ an immediate review.
gap.explain: Call for means demand or require.

mistake.sentence: The committee is comprised of five members.
mistake.explain: Use comprises, or is composed of.

mistake.sentence: He was accused for falsifying the records.
The results corroborate with earlier studies.
She objected to the proposal to be delayed.
mistake.explain: Use being delayed after object to.

mistake.sentence: The phenomenon is widely attributable for climate change.
The policy aims at reducing administrative burdens.
mistake.explain: Use aims to reduce, or targets reducing.

phrase.prompt: The company sought to ___ off its underperforming division.
phrase.explain: Spin off means separate part of a company.

phrase.prompt: The team had to ___ up with an unexpected delay.
phrase.explain: Come up with means produce a response or idea.

phrase.prompt: The regulator promised to ___ down on misleading advertising.
phrase.explain: Crack down on means act strongly against.

phrase.prompt: The project was ___ off due to funding problems.
phrase.explain: Shelve something means postpone it indefinitely.

phrase.prompt: The report ___ out several inconsistencies in the accounts.
phrase.explain: Point out means draw attention to.

phrase.prompt: They decided to ___ up the search after finding no evidence.

formation.prompt: The report questioned the ___ of the new procedure. (VIABLE)
formation.explain: Use the noun form of viable.

formation.prompt: The manager’s response was seen as ___. (EVADE)
The study provides strong ___ for the theory. (SUPPORT)
formation.explain: Use the noun form of support.

formation.prompt: The decision was criticised for its lack of ___. (INCLUDE)
formation.explain: Use the noun form meaning the quality of including people.
